name: us-college-research
description: US College Research Tool — structured university data, faculty research profiles, and opportunity discovery for prospective students
author: Gabriel

COLLEGE_SCORECARD_API_KEY.description: API key for the College Scorecard API (U.S. Department of Education). Get one free at https://api.data.gov/signup/

SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY.description: API key for Semantic Scholar (increases rate limits for faculty research lookups). Optional — tool works without it but may hit rate limits.

FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.description: API key for Firecrawl web search/scraping (increases rate limits). Optional — web search works without it on free tier.

EXA_API_KEY.description: API key for Exa semantic web search (removes rate limits). Optional — basic search works without it on free tier.
